table.name: TLGNU_FUNC
table.description: Application function. A function is the smalles authorization element. Usually it is good practice to define one function per application-screen. If a screen contains elements with special authorization requirements, add more function codes.

column.name: FUNC_ID
column.description: PK. The values are grouped to make it easier to introduce additional functions later if needed, without the need to reorganize existing functions. This ID is reflected as a constant in the code and must not be changed without changing the code.

column.name: FUNC_NAME
column.description: Short but meaningful name of the function. The constant in the code is called similar to this name.
